name: Indu
meaning: Indu stands for the moon, of which we have only one – hence it is the first chakra.

name: Netra
meaning: Nētra means eyes, of which we have two – hence it is the second.

name: Agni
meaning: Agni is the third chakra it indicates three kinds of Agni (Dakshina, Ahavaniyam and gArhapatyam). So agni indicates 3rd Chakra.

name: Veda
meaning: Vēda denoting four Vedas is the name of the fourth chakra.

name: Bana
meaning: Bāṇa comes fifth as it stands for the five Arrows of Manmatha.These arrows of Manmatha are mango, lotus, blue lily, jasmine and asoka. These arrows were to give the person hit by it have intense issues

name: Rutu
meaning: Rutu is the sixth chakra standing for the 6 seasons of Hindu calendar, which are Vasanta, Greeshma, Varsha, Sharat, Hemanta and Shishira.

name: Rishi
meaning: Rishi, meaning sage, is the seventh chakra representing the seven sages.

name: Vasu
meaning: Vasu stands for the eight vasus of Hinduism.

name: Brahma
meaning: Brahma comes next of which there are 9.

name: Disi
meaning: Disi Chakra indicates Ten directions(East, West, North, South, North East, North West, South East, South West, Above and Below). Hence it is 10th Chakra.

name: Rudra
meaning: Eleventh chakra is Rudra of which there are eleven.

name: Aditya
meaning: Twelfth comes Ādityas of which there are twelve.
